boards.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One polished concept-review board for Bullets of Fury Stage 6, two BRAND NEW enemies, HD-16-bit / Neo Geo pixel art with crisp deliberate clusters, chromium material highlights and dark outlines, coherent teal/white/cool gray wind palette. Widescreen1536x1024 layout, navy drafting-board background with very faint sky-cloud atmospheric strips only. Two distinct columns, no existing BOF characters or interface. LEFT: smaller WINDRAZOR miniboss, a sleek compact scissor-wing hunter jet with two parallel needle noses, narrow royal-blue canopy between them, white outer wing blades that hinge inward for a cutting rush, teal ramjet ducts, dark undercarriage. High top-down 3/4 view, nose facing south. Its action inset beneath shows those same wings closing and three slender wind slugs leaving the actual wing nozzles. RIGHT: much larger STRATOSPHERE LEVIATHAN boss, a broad asymmetric-free white and teal mechanical manta silhouette with swept crescent wings, exposed round teal pressure-heart in the center and TWO huge outboard centrifugal wind turbines on jointed pylons, four independently mounted narrow gun pods. Distinct silhouette from an aircraft carrier: no deck, no helicopter rotor, no humanoid. Small exploded-view inset beneath reveals separate full left/right wing, turbine, pod and intact core modules with clear non-overlapping spacing, dotted assembly guides. Design joints so true attack/recoil/turn frames can be made later. One small planned attack vignette shows a wind corridor with a visible navigable gap, no actual game screenshots. Exact labels only: 'STAGE 6 / OPTION A', 'WINDRAZOR', 'MINIBOSS', 'STRATOSPHERE LEVIATHAN', 'BOSS', 'CONCEPT ONLY'. Keep both whole silhouettes fully visible and cleanly separated. Do not imitate Razorwake, Thunderhead, Harrier or a conventional bomber. This is a concept board, NOT production sprite frames. No text paragraphs, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new Stage 6 alternative-enemy concept board for Bullets of Fury. Polished detailed Neo Geo HD16-bit pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, navy blueprint backdrop, white/cool gray armored machines with teal wind energy, restrained gold fasteners, dark seams. This board must be COMPLETELY DIFFERENT in silhouette from a jet, a manta, Razorwake, Harrier or an aircraft carrier. Widescreen1536x1024, fully visible separated subjects in two columns. LEFT MINIBOSS: DRAFT WIDOW, an agile mechanical dragonfly predator: narrow armored segmented insect fuselage with a small royal-blue cockpit eye, FOUR long transparent-looking rigid turbine lattice wings with pale-teal wind membranes, six articulated hooked landing legs folded around it. No organic human face. High top-down 3/4 shooter angle; nose faces south. Below show same insect banking into a fast lateral claw dash, and a separate small joint/wing-open pose. RIGHT BOSS: SKY ANVIL, a gigantic flying industrial grapple engine, triangular heavy hanging central gray-and-white anchor hull with a broad downward-facing armored jaw, held aloft by THREE massive distinct ducted wind turbines on long truss outriggers in a tripod. Visible teal pressure glass windows in main hull, twin independently pivoting slug cannons on the forward corners, a thick central retracting grappling hook beneath; turret housings and turbine mounts have real exposed mechanical joints. It must look like an industrial sky predator, NOT a bomber or ship deck, no humanoid. Bottom-right exploded assembly inset shows the three turbine-outrigger modules, two cannon modules and complete central hull separated cleanly; retain the same mass/proportions between inset and hero. One tiny planned action inset shows a visible grapple landing mark and wind streams pushing outward with space between, not a gameplay screenshot. Exact short labels: 'STAGE 6 / OPTION B', 'DRAFT WIDOW', 'MINIBOSS', 'SKY ANVIL', 'BOSS', 'CONCEPT ONLY'. No paragraphs or invented stats, no watermark, no game HUD. Generous padding, no clipped extremities. Visually rich sky-machine concept art, not production frames.

Use case: stylized-concept. One completely new concept-review board for Bullets of Fury Stage 6. Widescreen1536x1024, rich crisp Neo Geo HD16-bit pixel art with chrome highlights, navy schematic background, white/gray armor, deep gunmetal shadows and bright teal wind pressure. Two clearly separate complete enemy designs, NOT an aircraft carrier, not a manta ray, insect, conventional plane or humanoid. LEFT: CLOUD GUILLOTINE miniboss, a dangerous circular shear-wing drone: two huge opposing C-shaped white blade airfoils suspended from an angular diamond-shaped central thruster module with royal-blue pressure glass, the two C wings hinge like scissors around the body and open to a broad crescent shape. Two short real gun barrels are mounted to the fixed central module. It reads as a compact flying scissors machine, no giant eye. Beneath, two small poses show blade vanes open and closed with a controlled teal cutting gust. RIGHT: TEMPEST CHOIR boss, a monumental floating wind-organ engine, tall vertically arranged ribbed gray core with three white buoyancy pressure pods behind it, SIX independently jointed trumpet-like pressure cannons arranged in an arched fan around a brilliant teal turbine heart, large physically turning bell mouths with visible compressor vanes inside. Crown of angular swept wind vanes, exposed piston/bellows joints, two long stabilizer tails. Alien military industrial machine, aerodynamic and heavy, no gothic cathedral or musical instrument decoration; its wind-cannon silhouette should be unmistakable. Bottom-right exploded view separates six complete pressure cannon assemblies and three pressure pods from the central heart hull, with clean assembly gaps and socket guides. Small attack inset shows alternate cannons releasing bright slender wind crescents leaving a wide lane between alternating shots. All effects teal/white, NO green rings, no magenta or flame. Exact labels only 'STAGE 6 / OPTION C', 'CLOUD GUILLOTINE', 'MINIBOSS', 'TEMPEST CHOIR', 'BOSS', 'CONCEPT ONLY'. Keep subject silhouettes and protruding parts inside generous margins. Art for approval only, NOT production frames or game footage.

Use case: stylized-concept. One high-quality modular boss/miniboss concept board for Bullets of Fury STAGE 9, OPTION A,1536x1024 landscape. The two attached actual-game stills are ROLE/PALETTE references only: first is Event Horizon, spinning alien crescent spacecraft with an inner white optic; second is Tidal Sovereign, teal and blue hydraulic warship with spinning water fans. Create TWO entirely NEW designs FROM SCRATCH, do not edit or trace sprites, no existing game HUD, keep Stage9's VOID/SPACE environment rather than moving it to an ocean. Crisp detailed HD16-bit/Neo Geo pixel art, dark gunmetal/charcoal, chrome edges, royal-blue and aqua pressure glass, pale-white optic energy, subtle cyan symbiotic circuitry. Board navy background with faint distant space, clean two-column presentation, fully visible separated designs. LEFT miniboss 'EYE OF THE UNDERTOW': an alien tri-crescent spacecraft, three dark curved blade petals suspended from a compact core with ONE large white-cyan iris, each blade attached by its own exposed rotational shoulder joint and carrying a separate long thin laser projector near its tip. New threefold silhouette distinct from original two-wing horizon. Bottom-left exploded view shows the complete three blade-emitter modules and intact iris core with gaps/socket markers. RIGHT boss 'PELAGIC CROWN': an elegant enormous crown/manta hydraulic warship with a sharply swept teal armored main hull, broad blue heart reservoir, FOUR independent round water-fan pods on distinct jointed booms, FOUR forward-facing smaller water cannon turrets mounted on real sockets, chrome layered wing ridges and a long central nose. Angular silhouette with crownlike rear fins, not the exact old Sovereign plate. Bottom-right exploded view pulls all four complete fan-boom assemblies and the four complete cannon modules away from the intact central hull with clearly separated spacing. Small attack insets show iris petals spinning to sweep white lasers, and fan-launched arcing blue water grenades going upward then onto three marked landings; no bouncing ball arena. Exact short labels only: 'STAGE 9 / OPTION A', 'EYE OF THE UNDERTOW', 'MINIBOSS', 'PELAGIC CROWN', 'BOSS', 'CONCEPT ONLY'. No statistics paragraphs, no watermark, no clipping, no borrowed game UI. Concepts only, not production frames.

Use case: stylized-concept. Bullets of Fury STAGE 9 / OPTION B concept-review board,1536x1024 widescreen, TWO new modular enemies, made from scratch. Use attached actual Event Horizon and Tidal Sovereign stills only as material/palette/role reference. Keep VOID/SPACE stage; no ocean setting or game HUD. HD16-bit Neo Geo detailed pixel art, dark charcoal alien metal, chrome bevels, luminous aqua/royal blue water reservoirs and white-cyan optic energy. These designs must be very different from a three-crescent spinner and a manta-shaped water ship. LEFT MINIBOSS: ABYSSAL NAUTILUS, a sinister alien spiral spacecraft with a compact central white iris buried inside a segmented helicoidal armored shell. Four substantial independent shell sectors curl around the iris like a mechanically opening nautilus, black symbiotic cables across chrome seams, TWO long pivoting optic beam arms protrude from separate rear mounts. Not an organic snail on the ground: a weightless alien machine with exhaust vents and real gimbal joints. Bottom-left exploded view separates four complete curved shell sectors, both optic projector arms and intact eye core, with clear gaps/socket guides; a small action pose shows shell spread open while the full body corkscrew spins. RIGHT BOSS: TRENCH CATHEDRAL, a huge upright hydraulic dreadnought with THREE massive blue-glass water pressure reservoirs rising like a stepped crown, a squat central armored prow, FOUR independent cylindrical forward water cannons, TWO wide side-mounted water-fan booms and ONE large lower floodgate maw. Swept angular mechanical wings stabilize it, new towerlike silhouette; no real cathedral architecture, no humanoid, no aircraft deck. Every fan and barrel visibly has a mechanical socket, piston or hinge. Bottom-right exploded view cleanly detaches both fan-booms, four gun modules, three reservoir/cap assemblies and the intact central hull; show real complete modules, not cut-off rectangles. Attack vignette shows reservoirs filling, one central floodgate throwing a broad blue surge while gaps remain near the sides. Exact labels only: 'STAGE 9 / OPTION B', 'ABYSSAL NAUTILUS', 'MINIBOSS', 'TRENCH CATHEDRAL', 'BOSS', 'CONCEPT ONLY'. Both complete heroes prominent, consistent silhouette in insets, no clipping, no watermark, no detailed statistics. Approval art only, not production animation frames.

Use case: stylized-concept. New modular Stage9 alternative concept board for Bullets of Fury,1536x1024 wide, two original enemies designed from scratch. Attached current Event Horizon and Tidal Sovereign stills guide ROLE and PALETTE only, not shapes to trace. Maintain the space/void setting with faint stars and navy panels. Excellent HD16-bit Neo Geo pixel art, crisp chromium edges, charcoal alien hulls, deep teal and cobalt water chambers, bright white/cyan inner light. Very different silhouettes from triangular crescent spinner, nautilus shell, manta wing and reservoir tower. LEFT MINIBOSS: PRISM WRAITH, a long narrow diamond-shaped alien spindle with ONE luminous white iris in an armored square gimbal at center, FOUR long angular spearhead prism vanes held away from the body on separate articulated elbows, sharp polished chrome faces and cyan translucent optic slits. The vanes can fold into a compact diamond cage or unfold into a cross without changing identity. Each vane has a discrete beam projector facing outward. Below show one accurate unfolded pose and an exploded view with four COMPLETE vane/elbow/projector modules separated from intact spindle-eye core, consistent parts and pivots. RIGHT BOSS: RIPTIDE HYDRA, a large water-powered TRIDENT spacecraft: THREE long aggressive armored prow pods pointing south from a curved aft hydraulic spine, outer two pods each house a huge blue spinning water fan and a separate twin water cannon turret; the central longer prow contains a luminous blue pressure-heart and central floodgate. Rear two detachable reservoir shells feed transparent teal pipes to the three heads. No actual dragon heads, no humanoid, no legs: a triple-fuselage hydraulic war machine with menacing chrome fins. Bottom-right exploded inset separates the full two side prows, both cannon turrets, two rear reservoir shells and intact central hull, leaving every broken mount understandable instead of cutting a flat body image. Attack inset shows alternate left/right fan launchers firing high arcing water grenades, followed by the three prow pods charging forward in a staggered trident rush with visible gaps. Exact short labels only: 'STAGE 9 / OPTION C', 'PRISM WRAITH', 'MINIBOSS', 'RIPTIDE HYDRA', 'BOSS', 'CONCEPT ONLY'. Do not add a game HUD, stats paragraphs, water ground environment or borrowed sprites. Full silhouettes within margins. Review concepts only, NOT animation frames.
